source_name: NBS — Slovak-language relay of ECB payment/cash findings (aktuality)
why_relevant: Národná banka Slovenska republishes ECB SPACE / payment-attitudes findings in Slovak, often with SK-specific commentary the ECB report does not foreground. Also the best source of correct Slovak terminology for downstream local-language searching.

source_name: NBS – Správa o činnosti útvaru dohľadu v oblasti ochrany spotrebiteľa (consumer-protection supervision report)
why_relevant: Consumer-protection strand of supervision; complaints and findings about current accounts, payment services, card products and unauthorised transactions — an indirect read on real-world payment-product friction and volumes.

source_name: NBS – Téma NBS / thematic explainers (e.g. digital money, digital euro)
why_relevant: 'Téma NBS' longer-form explainer format inside the aktuality stream; covers digital euro and the future of cash vs digital money from the SK central-bank perspective. Signals NBS's stance ahead of formal policy.

source_name: NBS – Prístup do platobných systémov NBS (July 2025 document)
why_relevant: Concrete example of the NBS 'dokument' download endpoint: a July 2025 explanatory document on access to NBS payment systems, tied to opening SIPS/TARGET-SK to non-bank PSPs from 6 October 2025 — a structural change to the SK payments market.

source_name: NBS 'PTK – Open Data' procurement / preliminary market consultation documents
why_relevant: NBS procurement documents for an Open Data solution (data catalogue, data repository, presentation layer, API). These reveal the intended architecture, planned endpoints and dataset scope of NBS open data before it goes live — an early-warning pointer to future machine-readable NBS surfaces.

source_name: NBS – Metodika odboru štatistiky (statistics methodology note, PDF)
why_relevant: Methodological note explaining how NBS compiles transaction data (direct vs indirect method, revaluations, reclassifications). Essential for interpreting revisions and breaks in the payment/monetary series.

source_name: Národný plán zavedenia okamžitých platieb v SR (NBS + SBA + MF SR + Štátna pokladnica)
why_relevant: The national instant-payment scheme plan jointly produced by the banking association and the central bank; names participating PSPs, milestones and adoption thresholds. Core artefact for the national IPS scheme body dimension of this cell.

source_name: NBS legacy site (www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/…) – historical statistics and annual report chapters
why_relevant: The pre-migration NBS website still serves historical PDFs, including annual-report chapters dedicated to 'E. PLATOBNÝ STYK' (payment system) that carry older card/ATM/POS and payment-volume tables not present in the modern site tree. Important for reconstructing long histories before the site redesign; also proves that some legacy paths (e.g. www.nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje/platobny-styk) now 404 while the /_img/documents/ file store persists.

source_name: ECB SPACE 2020 report (first wave, baseline)
why_relevant: Baseline wave (2019 diary fieldwork, 17 euro area countries incl. Slovakia) needed to measure the SK cash-to-card shift over time rather than reading a single snapshot.

source_name: ECB Occasional Paper 201 — The use of cash by households in the euro area
why_relevant: The pre-SPACE (SUCH 2016) study establishing the long-run cash-usage baseline per country, incl. Slovakia; essential for a 2016→2024 cash decline narrative and for understanding the methodology lineage of SPACE.

source_name: ECB Seventh report on card fraud (legacy card-fraud series)
why_relevant: The discontinued ECB card fraud report series (through 2021) carrying CNP vs ATM vs POS fraud splits by country, incl. SK; needed for back-history before the EBA-ECB joint series began.

source_name: Joint EBA–ECB Report on Payment Fraud (annual, country breakdowns)
why_relevant: Successor to the ECB card fraud report series; semi-annual fraud data by instrument (cards, credit transfers, cash withdrawals, e-money) with per-country tables covering Slovakia. Directly relevant to ATM/POS fraud and SCA effects.

source_name: ECB payments statistics press releases (half-yearly), Slovak country tables
why_relevant: Half-yearly ECB payments statistics release with country tables including Slovakia; provides the release cadence, revision notes and a human-readable cross-check against API pulls of the NBS-reported card/terminal series.

source_name: ECB public consultation file on the payments statistics Regulation (FAQ + draft annexes)
why_relevant: Consultation FAQs and draft annexes reveal the reporting burden debate and the exact variable list (MCC breakdowns, remote/contactless, fraud typologies) — useful for anticipating which SK series will appear and which are derogated.

source_name: ECB SPACE 2024 — Annex B (country-level statistical annex)
why_relevant: The annexes carry the machine-extractable per-country tables (SK rows) behind the SPACE headline text — cash/card/mobile shares by transaction value band, location, and payment situation. This is where the usable Slovakia numbers actually live.

source_name: IFP — Manuál: Daňová medzera na DPH (VAT gap methodology)
why_relevant: Methodological manual for how Slovakia estimates the VAT gap; the manual and its updates are the reference for interpreting claims that eKasa or cashless-payment obligations reduced the shadow cash economy. Directly supports cash-usage analysis with an auditable method.

source_name: European Commission merger case file M.10378 (VUB / Slovenská sporiteľňa / Tatra banka JV)
why_relevant: EC merger file covering a joint venture of the three largest SK banks - such filings typically describe shared ATM/self-service infrastructure, supplier arrangements and market shares in the SK cash-access market, quantified in a way neither the banks nor their vendors publish.

source_name: BIS CPMI — Red Book statistics methodology (CPMI d168)
why_relevant: Definitive definitions for payment-statistics concepts (POS terminal, cash withdrawal, e-money, cashless payment) used across BIS, ECB and national reporting. Essential for making SK figures from different aggregators comparable without double counting.

source_name: Banky.sk — banking consumer portal (ombudsman/ADR explainers)
why_relevant: Documents the institutional history of the SK bank ombudsman and its replacement by ARS SBA — needed to interpret complaint time series and to locate archived ombudsman reports.

source_name: Tatra banka – Sadzobník poplatkov (fee schedule)
why_relevant: Sadzobník exposes ATM withdrawal pricing (own/foreign network), card issuance/maintenance fees and transaction-fee structure — the pricing side of cash vs card substitution.

source_name: VÚB banka – cenníky (fee schedules, retail and corporate)
why_relevant: Fee schedules reveal the card/ATM/POS product taxonomy of the bank (withdrawal fees at own vs foreign ATM, terminal rental, transaction fees) — a proxy for cash-usage economics and for how the bank segments card products.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – Informácie zverejňované ročne (NBS Opatrenie 16/2014 / Pillar 3)
why_relevant: ČSOB SK's annual Pillar 3 disclosure under NBS Opatrenie č. 16/2014; contains structured balance-sheet, business-line and network information for a top-5 SK bank whose SK-specific numbers are otherwise buried in KBC group reporting.

source_name: IMF — Slovak Republic Financial System Stability Assessment (FSAP)
why_relevant: Independent analytical intermediary that re-cuts NBS/ECB primary data into structural sector metrics (concentration, foreign ownership, payment-system oversight); free full PDF.

source_name: Printec Group - ATM & POS Landscape in CEE research series
why_relevant: Vendor-published multi-country (14 CEE markets) ATM/EFT-POS estate research that normally includes Slovakia rows - a rare vendor-side quantitative series on device counts and channel trends. Gated landing pages (offer.printecgroup.com) suggest lead-capture forms.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – Výročná správa (postal network as bank distribution/cash channel)
why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is the distribution partner of 365.bank/Poštová banka; its annual report quantifies post-office counts and financial-service transaction volumes — an indirect read on rural cash access and on Poštová banka's reach.

source_name: Mastercard Slovensko payment-behaviour survey releases (via SK trade/press channels)
why_relevant: Scheme-commissioned consumer research is the most frequent public source of SK mobile/card/cash preference splits (e.g. mobile payments 56% vs 21% in 2019); distributed through SK press-release wires rather than a stable corporate page.

source_name: Academic paper: Trends in the Development of the Payment Services Market — A case of Slovakia (Bobenič Hintošová et al.)
why_relevant: Concrete example of SK university research on the payment-services market; demonstrates that EUBA/UPJŠ-affiliated academics publish quantified SK payment analyses in open conference proceedings and on ResearchGate.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – List of supervised entities (SSM), Slovakia section
why_relevant: Periodic PDF listing significant and less-significant SK institutions with LEIs and group affiliation — resolves which SK banks are subsidiaries of foreign groups, key for interpreting acquiring/issuing market shares.

source_name: European Court of Auditors — Special Report 01/2025: Digital payments in the EU
why_relevant: Independent EU audit of digital-payments policy that compiles cross-member-state uptake figures (incl. instant payments) and audits the Commission's own data. Useful as an audited secondary compilation and as a pointer to the underlying datasets the Commission holds.

source_name: Forbes Slovensko - 'Banky sa svojimi IT dodávateľmi nechvália'
why_relevant: Key meta-source: SK business press piece explaining exactly why supplier-side evidence is scarce - banks white-label vendor work and sometimes contractually forbid suppliers from listing them as references. It also names vendors and their SK bank customers, so it doubles as an actor-map seed and as the rationale for the collection strategy of this cell.

source_name: Ipsos SK — Slovenská banková asociácia study on perception of banks
why_relevant: Named market-research vendor (Ipsos) publishing methodology and topline results of a representative SK banking-perception survey commissioned by the banking association; recurring series usable for attitudes toward banks, fees and digital payment.

source_name: KPMG SK newsroom - payments M&A notes (e.g. Solitea acquiring Pay Solutions)
why_relevant: Advisor deal announcements name SK payment-technology targets and acquirers that rarely publicise themselves (IT holding Solitea buying Pay Solutions). Advisory newsrooms are a systematic route to SK payment-vendor consolidation events and to discovering smaller processors/gateways.

source_name: LobbyFacts / EU Transparency Register datacard — Slovenská banková asociácia
why_relevant: Structured transparency-register profile of the association: declared budget, staff, EU-level interests and affiliations. Useful for assessing the association's capacity and bias when interpreting its statistics, and for confirming its federation memberships.

entity_name: Moody's multi-country rating action PDF covering Slovak banking groups
source_name: Moody's multi-country rating action PDF covering Slovak banking groups (depositor-preference actions)
why_relevant: Concrete example of a free full-text rating action naming SK banking groups; shows the artefact type worth harvesting systematically.

source_name: Mordor Intelligence – Slovakia POS Terminal Market report
why_relevant: Commercial market-sizing of the SK POS terminal market with vendor shares. Paywalled, but the free summary/TOC reliably names the vendors and segments the analyst considers material — useful as a cross-check on the actor map.

source_name: Regulation (EU) 2020/2011 (ECB/2020/59) on payments statistics — EUR-Lex
why_relevant: The legal instrument that forces Slovak PSPs to report card, terminal and fraud data to NBS and thence to the ECB. Reading the annexes tells you exactly which variables exist for SK before you go looking for them, and is available in Slovak on EUR-Lex.

entity_name: Sektorová rada pre bankovníctvo, finančné služby, poisťovníctvo
source_name: Sektorová rada pre bankovníctvo, finančné služby, poisťovníctvo — sector analysis (Národná sústava povolaní)
why_relevant: Tripartite sector council publishing a structured SK banking/payments sector analysis (SWOT, structural trends on instant payments, open banking, digital euro, branch reduction) — an unusual analytical channel most scans miss.

source_name: Tapeon s.r.o. - SK ISO-certified Visa/Mastercard payment solutions provider
why_relevant: Tapeon (founded 2015) is described as an official ISO-certified Visa/Mastercard partner in SK supplying terminals to independent merchants, retail chains, self-service kiosks and e-shops - i.e. a non-bank acceptance channel that sits outside bank acquiring disclosure. The llarik.sk overview also maps SK terminal fee structures and providers, making it a useful pointer to the long tail of SK payment vendors.

source_name: Visa Europe blog – Central Eastern Europe contactless insight posts
why_relevant: Example of scheme-published CEE country breakdowns (contactless share of Visa transactions, contactless-enabled card and POS terminal penetration incl. Slovakia) — the kind of metric only the scheme can produce.
